title: Origin story: Cinderella
description: Cinderella is the mistreated stepdaughter of hundreds of folk variants, who with a fairy godmother's — or a hazel tree's, or a dead mother's — aid attends the royal ball, loses a slipper of glass or gold, and is found by it. Her kindness to the small and weak is the constant across every telling.
